## Historical audit — S0060

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/test/commons_199974832/trajectory.jsonl`. Offsets below are half-open character ranges within the cited JSONL line.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1 [0,9988) | The assigned goal was to reconstruct a supplied indoor RGB image in Blender using SceneAct, with separate meshes, editable multipart objects, an estimated camera and materials. The request called for an image specification and a complete program. This is a task goal, not evidence that any scene feature was reconstructed. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2 [0,2635) | A fresh, read-only Codex session was launched with the staged image. It failed with exit code 1 after about 8.6 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls and no usage events. It does not expose all underlying inference rounds. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3 [0,551); `scene_error`, line 4 [0,1615) | The failure propagated from the student call through the scene loop. The error points to a stderr log, but its contents are not included, so the underlying cause is unknown. |

**Changes and validation.** No student program, scene build, render, revision, or validation is visible. The trace therefore does not establish whether multiple objects, materials or textures, connected parts, poses, camera, lighting, or rendering matched the photograph. The image path and task instructions are not visual evidence of its contents. No autonomous exploration is visible; tools were disabled in the recorded session. There is no visible teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution, or adoption.

**Outcome and lesson.** This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of an algorithmic reconstruction failure, partial geometric correctness, or an empty patch. No formal success or submitted successful build is shown. A transferable lesson is to distinguish a failed invocation from the quality of an unproduced scene; a task-specific unresolved hypothesis is what caused exit code 1. The referenced stderr and any image or artifact contents are not available in the supplied observations, so neither the cause nor a visual outcome can be independently verified.
